fusions.name: Resin Brand
fusions.desc: Burns 5% of your maximum health as fuel to throw a brand of resin at one enemy, dealing 9 damage and setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Backburn Front
fusions.desc: Sends fire through dry brush across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage and leaving every enemy hit [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Charcoal Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and attackers are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ashfall Mulch
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
